summary.headline: Augmont's SPOT platform PAT rose to Rs.85 Crores in Q2 FY27 (2.5x YoY) as scrap recycling lifted margins even as enterprise revenue fell 32%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 was Augmont's first earnings call after its August 2026 listing. Management said the core SPOT platform PAT rose to Rs.85 Crores from Rs.34 Crores a year earlier, with PAT margin at 0.65% versus 0.18%, while enterprise revenue fell 32% as the company shifted sourcing toward recycled scrap gold, which ties up working capital for about four days versus under two for imported bars. Consumer (Gold For All) revenue rose 47% YoY and accounted for 13% of revenue versus 7% in FY26. Management declined to give revenue, margin or volume guidance, and said the IPO primary proceeds (Rs.625 Crores net of expenses) were deployed into working capital.

segments.name: Augmont SPOT (enterprise / B2B)
segments.commentary: Accounted for about 93% of FY26 revenue. Q2 FY27 PAT Rs.85 Crores and EBITDA Rs.113 Crores, but enterprise revenue fell 32% YoY as capital was shifted to lower-turn scrap procurement.

segments.name: Gold For All (consumer / B2C)
segments.commentary: Consumer revenue up 47% YoY; 13% of Q2 FY27 revenue vs 7% in FY26. Covers digital gold and silver, SIP, EMI Jewellery, coins and bars, gold loans (via NBFC partners) and sell-old-gold.

segments.name: Diamonds marketplace (new)
segments.commentary: Started recently with about 1 million stones listed and about 8,000 carats sold and about 250 dealers; operates as a marketplace without inventory.

segments.name: Electronic Gold Receipts (EGR, with NSE)
segments.commentary: Augmont is an authorised EGR liquidity provider and collection centre; management expects the product to go live in the current quarter, with no revenue quantification given.

guidance_outlook: No numerical guidance on FY27 revenue growth or margins; management said both can vary with gold/silver prices, business mix, sourcing and market conditions.
Management said it would not put a revenue or profit figure on the incremental working capital from the IPO, and that deployment depends on opportunities, spreads and return thresholds.
Plan to expand SPOT delivery centres from 20 to 35 over the next couple of years, with 10 centres identified to start in the current financial year.
Aspiration to become an LBMA-accredited refinery.
Scrap procurement expected to remain at healthy levels; management did not give a target share.
capex_capacity: Refining capacity of 284 metric tonnes across two refineries (Rudrapur, Uttarakhand and Navi Mumbai).
Management said refiners globally run high daily capacity with low annual utilisation, so low utilisation is structural and not a loss driver.
20 SPOT delivery centres today; 10 more planned in FY27 toward 35 over the next couple of years.
Gold For All stores up from 118 to 122 in the quarter; retail point distribution centres up from 731 to 751; retail touch points up from 5,517 to 5,558.
Entire Rs.620 Crores of fresh issue stated as utilised per RHP objectives (working capital).
demand_pricing: Gold prices up about 40% YoY, raising working capital needs; management could not forecast gold prices.

Margins described as market-determined on both gold and silver with no fixed margin; spreads on scrap come from the bid-ask on procurement, handling and refining fees, and the margin on refined bars sold.
Q2 FY27 revenue fell because the company prioritised scrap procurement (working capital cycle about four days vs under two for imported doré/bars).
Recycling in India estimated at 300-400 tonnes a year; national jewellery chains increasingly request India Good Delivery bars.
Registered customers on the platform rose from 50.6 million to 52.3 million; 54 million retail customers cited on the call.

qa_highlights.question: What is the time and value contribution of EGR to topline and bottom line?
qa_highlights.answer: Sachin Kothari said it is too early to quantify EGR; near-term focus is building the ecosystem, and the product is expected to start in the current quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Will scrap procurement stay high, or will doré imports return to the 40-45% norm?
qa_highlights.answer: Ketan Kothari said scrap will stay at healthy levels given jewellers' old-for-new exchange programmes; doré imports will continue and depend on the India-international price disparity.

qa_highlights.question: Why did revenue fall and what did the IPO money fund?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said working capital was the constraint, scrap raises the cycle to about four days, and the Rs.625 Crores primary proceeds (net of expenses) went to working capital; no incremental revenue target was given.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook for October and H2 FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Ketan Kothari gave no numerical guidance and said the company will prioritise profitable growth and return ratios over revenue for its own sake.

qa_highlights.question: Is a debtor balance of Rs.700-800 Crores recurring?
qa_highlights.answer: Amit Kumar Solanki said the receivables were month-end sales realised in the first week of October, and it would not be a recurring pattern because advances vary.

qa_highlights.question: How much of procurement is scrap, and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Ketan Kothari said scrap rose from about 3% in Q2 FY26 to about 24.5% in Q2 FY27 and is expected to remain at healthy levels; no target share was given.

risks_watch: Revenue decline (enterprise down 32%) if margins do not offset lower turnover; management provided no revenue guidance.
Margin sustainability: management would not commit to a margin range and said margins vary by metal, mix and sourcing opportunity.
Working capital intensity: scrap cycle of about four days versus under two for imports, with no bank leverage permitted for gold businesses.
Gold price volatility (about 40% YoY rise) affecting working capital needs and prices.
Execution on 10 new SPOT delivery centres and the EGR launch with NSE; timing of EGR revenue unknown.
Receivables: about Rs.700-800 Crores of debtors at period-end cited by an analyst; management said this is not recurring. Watch the Q3 receivables number.
summary.management_tone: Confident on profitability and the recycling strategy, but cautious and non-committal on forward revenue, margins and volumes. Management repeatedly declined numerical guidance and deferred on EGR economics and capital deployment.
key_quotes: So, the entire lifecycle is covered through our B2B and B2C platforms.
What we see our business is that our business is always about the spreads between the buys and the sell and also on the capital efficiency as to how long is the capital going to be blocked for.
Our focus is not on driving the turnover just for the sake of growth, but our focus is on deploying the capital efficiently into opportunities that generate healthy returns for the company.
